# stablemap

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This package provides statistical methods for stabilized disease mapping
and tools for generating space-time simulation data.
The supported methods include:

- Stabilized Kriging ([Hsu et al., 2023](https://doi.org/10.2188/jea.JE20210276))
- Stabilized Spatiotemporal Kriging ([Tsai et al., 2022](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12874-022-01749-9))
- Age-Period-Cohort Kriging

## Installation

You can install the development version of `{stablemap}` from GitHub with:

```{r}
#| eval: false
pak::pak("darentsai/stablemap")
```
